node.title: M31 depth-32 uniform intercept 1233 counterexample
node.closure: explicit construction plus two independent exact finite-field replays
node.statement: On the pinned auxiliary Mersenne-31 c=2048, (u,v)=(0,1) quotient profile, one explicit 479-support anchor has at least 1237 distinct same-depth-32-prefix neighbors at deficiency 192: 1225 whole-T64 triple exchanges and 12 mixed T16 exchanges. Since 33<=192<=213, the uniform in-band cap d_e(A)<=1233 is false. This independently reconstructs draft upstream PR #1102 at support level. It proves no replacement upper bound, received-word realization, first-match survival, row payment, endpoint movement, or 2^-128 Prize-row statement.
